description: "Sharing Her Crime: A Novel" by May Agnes Fleming is a fiction work likely written in the late 19th century. The story revolves around dark themes of ambition, deceit, and moral ambiguity, focusing on the motivations of the main character, Madge Oranmore, as she plots the demise of her rival, Esther, to secure her son Barry's fortune.
